title: The maths the gurus don’t know — free
lead: Probability, statistics and quantitative finance, explained in plain words and in textbook form, with simulations and exercises at five levels.
status: The app is being built. Lessons are still being written and accounts aren’t switched on yet; below is what exists and what is coming.
simTitle: Flip a coin a thousand times
simNote: Not a picture but a running simulation. Change the settings and see how many “patterns” appear from pure chance.
tryNote: No account needed. Your result is kept in this browser only.
aboutBody: This project sells no courses, signals or “strategies”. It teaches the maths you need to judge such offers yourself: expected value, variance, risk management and what past results really say. There are no testimonials or user counters here, because there is nothing to prove with marketing.
